verbatim_quote.original: ZAC holds: XML must never contain git add/commit/push.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: ZAC holds: XML must never contain git add/commit/push.

extracted_decision.summary: Zero-Autonomous-Commit holds; XML must never contain git add, git commit, or git push.
extracted_decision.rationale: ZAC policy forbids autonomous committing by the Hands.
alternatives: Permit commits only after human approval
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Safety against unintended commits versus reduced automation; Strict process compliance versus convenience
